body:
The distinct eight-private-ray Endpoint screen is closed as **rejected**. This turn also found and corrected an active/capacity ownership mistake in the private implementation. Canonical source remains 630844e775a85e74eb5d9ed328a2b8019abb640d; no production selection or PR 62 source changed.

The first version moved scratch/status/projection to per-invocation Private storage, emitted LocalSize 8 with no barriers/atomics/Workgroup variables, and actually called an ordinary LVP eight-wide entry with observed dimensions (8,1,1). Its two vector scratch allocations total 100480 bytes; called executable text 933075 bytes, +1.1357% versus stock. All 55 ordinary feature fields matched stock; no feature override. These are compiler/called-code facts, not speed claims.

Original C1 passed all four routes in 111.173 s, with all 56 active-row readbacks equal to the preserved original. One fixed A1/B1/B2/A2 trial also completed the entire original C8 in each slot: all 32 active-row readbacks and 54 command/module joins matched across current arms. The C8 executions supplied both correctness observations and timing, avoiding a separate duplicate run. Raw unchanged gates passed 10/20 interval/stage checks and 2/2 provisioning-inclusive API checks. No retry, pooled order, extra warmup, excluded cost or frame attempt followed.

**The initial API-wide ownership proof was wrong:** inputs[0] is allocation capacity, while host group count limits active rows. At capacity 24 / active 12, the first mapping visits and zeroes rows 0..23, including 12 inactive rows. The original C1/C8 comparisons cover active spans; they do not observe the inactive allocation. This is a verified source-level counterexample, not a claimed captured tail-byte transition. The original frozen finisher was not executed because it omitted that check; a superseding review marks the experiment invalid for acceptance. The version is rejected independently of its failed raw cost gates.

Corrected source reads NumWorkgroups.x independently of capacity and checks it before output writes, preserving the host dispatch and descriptor/buffer ABI. The changed module 11cfc5021961123e24e701baaaee68c7c62bd627fb47ade746749ebc77653b6f compiled/validated. An independent emitted-CFG check explored 53 inactive-path states and proved every path returns before any store/call. A new C1-only observer source adds full-allocation before/after snapshots outside Endpoint calls and requires nonzero inactive-tail witnesses in every exercised route. The original C8 timing body stays byte-exact. **That observer has not been compiled/run; the corrected module has no actual-JIT, numerical-tail or cost qualification yet.** First-version evidence does not qualify it.

Published checkpoints: [rejection 32cf94d3](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/32cf94d3dec0cafb54596300e793915376cf9665) (192-file closed source/JIT/control/trial archive and counterexample); [corrected source 65a46624](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/65a466249d923a4b8c2ce1a02496cafdaa2e733a) (51-file compiler/source checkpoint). Branch: development/software-crossray-endpoint-2026-10-20. The rejected workspace can be retired against its Git-backed manifest; the corrected bounded source root remains for the next qualified witness. Issue 44, every original acceptance criterion and the ultimate scientific/runtime/release goal remain open.
